Which of the following data structures is most suitable for implementing an efficient priority queue with dynamic insertions?

A priority queue requires efficient retrieval of extreme elements. In a Binary Heap, elements can be inserted in O(log n) time and the minimum or maximum element can be extracted in O(log n) time, whereas an array or linked list would require O(n) for either insertion or extraction.
